data_quality.authentication: Provided official-format checksum pairs; independent official retrieval required for authenticity

evaluation_policy: Prequential completed-history memory, including earlier resolved validation events; normalizer and all parameters frozen. Not frozen-training-bank blind OOS.

independent_audit.method: Independent Fraction adverse-fill verification, Decimal commission/PnL/risk, next-open, SL/TP/gap touches, one-position overlap, cash reconstruction, mark-to-market equity and drawdown. Conditional gap outcomes are not asserted investable.

normalization_shift.note: Descriptive clipping counts with frozen2020Q1 scaler; no refit to improve validation.

protocol.anchor_phase: segment index divisible by16, after1000-bar execution warmup
protocol.exits: Independent family hypotheses use formal invalidation. ALL meta-router uses protective stops/targets and UTC daily timed exit only; analog banks use exactly that UNIVERSAL exit model. No exit reinterpretation as entry family changes.
protocol.multiple_search_note: 869=810 prior Pattern hypotheses+42 current+17 prior Lab versions; earlier exploratory searches not exhaustively counted, hence research only and no confirmed/blind edge claim.
protocol.normalizer: Only2020Q1 closed states; frozen means/std>=0.1; standardized vector clipped+-5. Calibration not included in trading metrics.
protocol.router: RULE priority frozen family order; NEAREST smallest mean distance without edge gate (baseline); EDGE lower95 block-mean positive,PF>=1.1,positive14day-block fraction>=2/3 and>=8blocks; never production-approved.

rules.BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION: New confirmed close breakout; EMA direction agrees, ADX>=25 and relative volume>=1.5.
rules.BREAKOUT_RETEST: Within8 bars after breakout (not same bar), touch0.25ATR level zone and confirming directional body/close beyond0.1ATR.
rules.FAILED_BREAKOUT_REVERSAL: Within8 closed bars of breakout, close back through broken level by0.1ATR; choose opposite side.
rules.RANGE_MEAN_REVERSION: ADX<=20 and prior50 width<=6ATR; range position<=.15 with RSI<=40 LONG or >=.85 and RSI>=60 SHORT.
rules.TREND_PULLBACK: ADX>=25, full15m/1h/4h EMA alignment, pullback depth0.5..2ATR and directional candle body.
rules.VOLATILITY_EXPANSION: ATR/close versus previous64 median>=1.5, volume>=1.5, breakout in EMA direction.

protocol.safety: OFFLINE_ONLY; no web routing, private-account imports, portfolio DB access or execution activation.

similarity.metric: Equal7-family RMS standardized Euclidean; exact family,side,regime,structure-mask,MTF-mask,volume availability

stress.signal_policy: Same frozen baseline-cost signals, no stress retuning

protocol.validation_note: Temporal validation only:2023-24 already seen in prior studies.2025 is already observed and NOT run or optimised here. New forward period required.

limitations: Experimental operational SMC definitions; no claim about institutional orders.
